mapper.select: SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",p.ORGNL_CTRT_AMT AS "originalAmount", (SELECT sum(PLAN_MM) FROM TB_PJ_MNPW_PLAN m WHERE m.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID) AS "planMm", p.REG_DTTM::date AS "registeredDate" FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p ORDER BY p.PROJ_ID
SELECT PROJ_ID AS "projectId",EXPS_YM AS "month",EXPS_AMT AS "amount" FROM TB_PJ_DRCT_EXPS ORDER BY PROJ_ID,EXPS_YM,EXPS_SN

SELECT s.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",s.STEP_SN::int AS "stepSn",s.PROJ_STEP_CD AS "stepCode", COALESCE(c.CODE_NM,s.PROJ_STEP_CD) AS "stepName",s.STEP_WGHT_RT AS "weight", s.PLAN_BGN_DT AS "startDate",s.PLAN_END_DT AS "endDate",s.CMPL_DT AS "completedDate", s.REG_USER_ID AS "registeredBy",COALESCE(r.USER_NM,s.REG_USER_ID) AS "registeredName", s.REG_DTTM AS "registeredAt",s.MOD_USER_ID AS "modifiedBy", COALESCE(u.USER_NM,s.MOD_USER_ID) AS "modifiedName",s.MOD_DTTM AS "modifiedAt" FROM TB_PJ_STEP s LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='PROJ_STEP' AND c.CODE=s.PROJ_STEP_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER r ON r.USER_ID=s.REG_USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.USER_ID=s.MOD_USER_ID ORDER BY s.PROJ_ID,s.STEP_SN
SELECT PROJ_ID AS "projectId",MEMO_SN::int AS "memoSn",WRT_DT AS "writtenDate",ACTL_PRGRS_RT AS "actualProgress" FROM TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO ORDER BY PROJ_ID,WRT_DT DESC,MEMO_SN DESC
SELECT PROJ_ID AS "projectId",IMPR_CD AS "importance",DDLN_DT AS "dueDate",ISSUE_STAT_CD AS "status" FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE ORDER BY ISSUE_ID

SELECT s.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",s.USER_ID AS "userId",COALESCE(u.USER_NM,s.USER_ID) AS "userName" FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.USER_ID=s.USER_ID WHERE s.SCOPE_TYPE_CD='PROJ' ORDER BY s.PROJ_ID,s.USER_ID,s.SCOPE_SN
SELECT ASGN_ID FROM TB_PJ_ASGN WHERE ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' ORDER BY ASGN_ID
SELECT CODE AS "code",ADD_VAL2 AS "contractTypes" FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP_ID='PROJ_STEP' AND USE_YN='Y' AND DEL_YN='N' ORDER BY SORT_ORD,CODE
